subject: science
concept: Conducting a simple guided investigation and recording what was observed
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Science and Engineering Practices (Planning and Carrying Out Investigations) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student performs a simple guided investigation (e.g. what floats/sinks) and records results
exercise.pictorial: Student draws or checks off what happened during the investigation on a simple results sheet
exercise.abstract: Student states what they found out from their investigation

assessment.mastery_threshold: records results accurately and states a conclusion connected to those results
misconception_flags: states a conclusion unconnected to what was actually observed during the investigation

interest_binding: investigation topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
